faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Why are BMP files so big?
faq.a1: BMP is an uncompressed format that stores every pixel individually. JPG compresses this data to save space.
faq.a2: JPG is a lossy compressed format, but the difference is usually indistinguishable to the human eye at high quality settings.
